key_insight: The paper argues that autonomous AI should continuously model its own hardware aging so it can adapt decisions before degradation causes mission failure.
engineering_relevance: This framework is relevant for long-lived, safety-critical autonomous systems because it connects prognostics with planning, resource management, and graceful degradation.
method: Continuously estimate the health of power, sensing, memory, and compute subsystems using physics-of-failure models.
Adapt inference complexity, planning horizon, and task priorities to match remaining hardware capability.
Allocate remaining operational life across mission goals through optimization, conservation, and graceful degradation.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual framework and application domains rather than reporting experimental results or quantitative evaluation.
watch_item: A practical challenge is reliably estimating hardware health in real time without adding excessive sensing, compute, or control overhead.
paper_title: Machines that know they are aging: a framework for hardware-aware autonomous intelligence
